notes.drawing: After the Olivestep mark, without the legs: an olive tilted 20° to the right (radii 60 and 78), a short stem from its top, and a leaf going up to the left, drawn as two circular arcs 16 units each side of its centerline. The fill keeps the stem as a line, as Phosphor's orange does; the duotone tints only the olive.
notes.bold: The leaf bulges 20 units each side instead of 16, so an 8-unit opening stays inside it (it closed up at 16).
